Overview

The ThermaView 960 brings high-definition thermal imaging to FPV flight. Its third-generation image enhancement produces sharper outlines and makes heat sources stand out clearly — ideal for search and rescue, security, industrial inspection and firefighting.

Video is sent simultaneously over the HD digital link and via USB (UVC), so you can fly while recording or analysing the image on a computer or AI system on the ground or on board.

Key features

HD thermal vision960 × 768 processed, 50 Hz.
F1.0 optics9.1 mm focal length, 48.3° × 38.6°.
1–4× zoomStepless, controllable via UVC.
5 palettesBrightness and contrast 0–100.
Dual outputHD link + USB UVC simultaneously.
Custom OSDCustom text overlays via ADKEY.

In the box

  • Thermal camera
  • Image processing module
  • Available in two versions: GT8 link or PX link

Compatibility

GT8 version: requires the AeroLink GT8 VTX transmitter, with the ground unit set to race mode. PX version: requires the AeroLink PX transmitter.

Applications

  • Search and rescue

  • Industrial and solar PV inspection
